title: Go where death loses its swagger
summary: The line keeps shelter, remembrance, and belonging braided together. Keep this close: Hold onto this: move toward the humble until fear loses its command.
lifeApplication: Before the next reply, raised voice, or hard stare, leave the doorway and sit near the quieter person in the room. Let humble company lower the body before anger calls itself courage.

source.shortMeaning: Humble company lowers fear and brings the heart under grace.
source.lifeApplication: When the body prepares to fight, move toward the humble before speaking.
